GST & PAN Guidelines 

For All Opportunities: 

  • Please ensure the PAN number is filled in for GST Exempt opportunities. 
  • The PAN number must match the one associated with the Account. 
  • If the PAN number is not available in the Account, please contact the Corporate Salesforce Team. 

For Existing-New Opportunities: 

  • If you select "Quote to be sent", attaching a quotation is mandatory. 
  • If you select "Quote not to be sent", the opportunity must be submitted for approval. 

To submit an “Existing-New” opportunity for approval: 

  • Ensure a contract is tagged. 
  • The PAN number is filled in. 
  • At least one business detail is attached.
